claims.sourceText: Salas, Great Falls Tribune interview (1996); signed affidavit published by Robert Hastings; 'Faded Giant' (2005)
claims.text: Salas states that while on duty in a Minuteman launch control capsule at Malmstrom in March 1967 he received a report from topside security police of a glowing red object over the front gate, and that his flight's missiles then went off alert.

topics.title: Missile sites, 1964-1968: Malmstrom, Minot and Big Sur
